title: I Don’t Like It
text: I Don’t Like It. The quality on this pillow is great. It feels nice and soft. The cover is comfortable. The strap is super silky and soft. The memory foam is not too dense, but not too soft. However, I just don’t like the shape or feel. I tried between my thighs, I didn’t like how that angled my legs. Tried between the knees— it just fit awkwardly. Tried between the ankles— super uncomfortable. I think I just don’t like have my hips and legs perfectly stacked while on my side. I tend to want one leg further forward than the other, or tipped slightly toward my stomach. You can’t vary your position much with this pillow. You can lay perfectly on your side with legs stacked evenly on top of one another. I just don’t sleep like that, so the pillow doesn’t work for me at all.
